newsitem.title: USA: Belco completing oil well in Louisiana.
newsitem.headline: Belco completing oil well in Louisiana.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp said Friday that it is currently completing the second of its dual lateral Turner 22 well in St. Landry Parish, La.

The independent natural gas and oil company said that on initial tests, the first lateral flowed at a rate of 5,100 barrels of oil per day (bpd) and 17 million cubic feet per day of natural gas (mmcf).
Belco said it has a 100 percent working interest in this well until payout and 77-1/2 percent thereafter. The well is expected to be flowing in the near future, it said.

The company said drilling is expected to commence shortly in each of the previously announced areas of mutual interest with Union Pacific Resources Group Inc and with Occidental subsidiary, OXY USA. It said it expects to have four rigs running in the the Louisiana Austin Chalk by the end of the second quarter.

In south Texas, the company said its 50-plus square mile seismic program targetting the Frio and Wilcox formations has been completed. Drilling at the Frio formation is expected to begin in the second quarter, it said.

In Wyoming, it said it expects to participate in about 30 new wells in the Moxa Arch area in the second half of 1997. In March the Bureau of Land Management authorized the resumption of drilling in the area.
